CONDITIONAL: QA1 gate-1 audit, sprint 2, round 1. VERDICT: CONDITIONAL (one requirement not met, rest are good).
Audited: HEAD 3c00022 (code in 5ca5c50; 3c00022 is start-bookkeeping only). Working tree clean. Sprint file re-read fresh; its only change since creation is the status frontmatter line. No criterion of the between-two-versions kind, so the sprint-9 check does not apply.
Checks run: npm test 257 pass / 8 skipped; npm run typecheck clean; npm run lint clean. The 8 skipped DB tests were run against the running local stack with its local keys: 14/14 pass (uniqueness 23505, forced profile-failure rollback plus same-email retry, emailTaken, RLS read/update/column refusals).

REQUIRED FIX (blocking):
1. Req 16 / AC17 not met: the no-literal-colour check still scans only app and lib. tests/no-literal-colors.test.ts line 14 is SCAN_DIRS = [app, lib], unchanged in this commit. Demonstrated: npx vitest run tests/no-literal-colors.test.ts --reporter verbose lists every scanned file, and none of the 7 tracked files under components/ (AvatarPicker, TabBar, ui/Button, ui/LinkButton, ui/PasswordInput, ui/TextInput, ui/button-style) appears, nor proxy.ts at the repo root. The requirement names components/ explicitly. A colour literal added to components/TabBar.tsx today would pass CI. (git grep shows no literal there right now, so this is a missing guard, not a live leak.) Fix: scan every application source directory (components/ and root-level .ts like proxy.ts included), ideally by walking the repo minus node_modules, .next, tests, public, docs and supabase, so the next new directory is covered automatically. Apply the same list to the arena-scan block in tests/arenas.test.ts (line 74 has the same app+lib gap). My own manual AC13 grep over components/ and proxy.ts found no threshold or arena name, so AC13 itself is met.

SHOULD FIX (non-blocking, fix now while in there):
2. Landing layout vs copy doc: screen-copy.md Landing table says the tagline Earn trophies / Climb arenas sits ABOVE the logo, but app/page.tsx renders the Image first and the tagline after it. The table also lists a Host caption, which suggests a host image on frame 1.00 that the page lacks. Check against frame 1.00 before LiveQA fails it on AC1.
3. Display-name length mismatch between JS and the DB: validation uses String.length (UTF-16 units), but the DB check uses char_length (code points). node shows a single emoji has .length 2 and 1 code point. That name passes the shared module, then the insert fails with check_violation 23514, the auth user is rolled back, and the player sees the generic fallback instead of Need at least 2 characters. Six emoji (12 units, 6 code points) is wrongly rejected as too long. Count code points in the module so browser, server and DB agree.
4. SignupForm: server fieldErrors take precedence over live client errors and are never cleared until the next submit, so a taken display name keeps its taken message after the player edits it. Clear a server error when its field changes.
5. signupAction has no try/catch around createAccount or the post-create signInWithPassword. supabase-js usually returns errors rather than throwing, but createAdminClient throws on missing env and a thrown fetch would reach the error boundary with no fallback message (NFR-7). loginAction already handles this; do the same here.
6. ProfilePage on a profile-load failure (e.g. an orphaned credential after a failed rollback) redirects to /login, which proxy bounces to /home. It does not loop, but the player gets no message. Acceptable for this sprint because it is logged; noting it.

VERIFIED MET: Req 1 (proxy redirects, tested); 2 (picker matches design-tokens spec: 68x68, snap x mandatory and center, 15px gap, 45px padding, 2.5px accent ring via token, accessible name Choose your avatar. with the full stop, ten ids matching public/avatars); 3 (one module lib/validation/signup.ts imported by the form and re-run server-side in createAccount, messages verbatim, reserved list matches the Starter opponents section exactly, AC3 unit cases all present); 4 (unique index on lower(display_name), DB test, 23505 mapped to taken); 5 (controlled local state, tested); 6 (read line by line: only the rollback-delete-failure path and a process crash between createUser and insert can orphan a credential. The first is logged loudly, the second is inherent to two systems. Forced-failure test passes live); 7 (admin createUser with email_confirm true, no email API anywhere); 8 (RLS select/update own, column-level update grant on exactly three columns, revoke all, no insert/delete; runtime tests pass); 9 (credentials vs generic mapping, tested; Forgot Password omitted as allowed); 10 (proxy.ts per Next 16, getUser not getSession, next param never read, every page re-checks getVerifiedUser, no handler takes a user id from body or query); 11 (tab bar with aria-current, home copy verbatim, arena label from getArenaForTrophies, play and leaderboard empty shells, tutorial redirects); 12 (UTC MMM D, YYYY tested; native dialog; signOut via cookie client); 13 (single ARENAS, thresholds and labels correct, boundary tests incl. 0/199/200/599/600/2999/3000/100000, six backgrounds as CSS vars in tokens.css); 14 (44px/8px inputs, 52px/10px buttons via radius tokens, accent focus border, type-error in color-error-text below the field, aria-describedby association, focus-visible outline); 15 (errors logged, no swallowed catch in app code); 17 health route uses the no-session anon client, grant unchanged, test asserts cookies never read and 200 ok.

Re-audit scope once fixed: the scan-path change plus whichever of items 2 to 5 Dev Team takes; the rest of the diff will not need a full re-read unless it moves.
